title: Everything You Are Looking For Is Right Where You Are
paragraphs: Everything possesses the seed of his destiny, including you. And God hides everything inside of it. In other words, you possess your future, not tomorrow, and yet it's not ahead ofyou. It's within you now, which means you don't go to your future, you revealyour future. You manifest it. Your future is alwayswith you. So, what you were born to dois trapped within you. And that's why I always tell my story about my oilfarmer. My oil farmer is something else. Never forget, true story.

A farmer in Texas had a wonderful farm, but he heard that they had struck oil out in the West Coast and in and inAlaska. He decided to sell his farm to go and find his fortune and his future. He sold his farm for $38,000. It was worth $112,000, but he wanted themoney so badly sold it cheap. He took the money, bought some donkeys, somepickaxes, and and some carriages, and went out to the West Coast years ago tofind his future.

He went to prospect for oil and silverand gold up there in the in the in in the West Coast, and he stayed there for6 months. 6 months later, the guy who bought thefarm, his neighbor, began to dig for water and discovered that this blackstuff started coming up on the same farm the guy sold him, and it was oil. It wasthe largest sale of oil in Texas. When the news got out to the West Coast, the guy discovered that it was his farm. He dropped dead on the donkey and died of a heart attack. It's a true story.
And the guy who bought the farm for $38,000 became a multimillionaireovernight. And the story really, the moral of it is thateverything you're looking for is right where you are.
